name: BioRender
description: Search BioRender's library of scientific templates, find your files, and generate custom first-draft figures with AI. Results and previews appear right in your conversation, and every item links back to BioRender so you can open and keep editing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BioRender to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BioRender to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.services.biorender.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BioRender MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BioRender provides these MCP tools: search-biorender, render-figure, custom-figure-get-preview-job, custom-figure-create-session, custom-figure-get-session, and custom-figure-confirm-preview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BioRender?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BioRender in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
BioRender requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BioRender is developed by BioRender. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
